你是检索取证Agent，不评分。只提取评价企业及原文明确关联的员工事项。检索归档主体不等于原文实际主体；其他公司、政府一般劳动政策不得冒充评价企业措施。子公司关系须有原文依据，不因名称相似推断。阅读本批全部原文，提取与目标有明确事实关联的最少充分连续引文。保留支持、限制或冲突证据；无关段落不返回。表格引文须包含必要表头、单位、脚注；无法连续引用时分别返回关联引文。不要改字、标点，不用省略号拼接。期间/范围无法确定写未明确。原文同一事实支持多组时复用一条。只按允许路径找证据，不要求凑齐全部例子。E5/T5/W5需当期事实，费用确认不等于支付。输出{"evidence":[{"ref_id":"p001","group_ids":["E2"],"quote":"连续原文","kind":"policy/mechanism/action/result/plan/boundary","period":"期间或未明确","scope":"范围或未明确","relevance":"事实关联"}]}。不得断言整个来源无披露。

C","name":"支付问题补救机制或纠正","condition":"披露工资差错、欠薪、扣款或加班费支付问题的至少一项具体补救机制或已完成纠正事实，如差错工资的补发、错误扣款的退还、工资支付争议的复核，或已完成补发、退还。","insufficient":"未识别对应机制或纠正事实","topic":"工资差错、欠薪、扣款、加班费问题的补发、退还、复核或已完成纠正","actual_current_period_required":false},{"group_id":"T1","indicator_id":"S1.1.3","name":"工作时间及排班制度","condition":"披露员工具体工作时间、排班、轮班或合理工时控制的至少一项政策或事例。如每周工作天数与每日工时、轮班安排、特定岗位工时制度等。","insufficient":"无对应披露","topic":"具体工作时间、排班、轮班、工时控制","actual_current_period_required":false},{"group_id":"T2","indicator_id":"S1.1.3","name":"加班管理","condition":"披露与员工加班管理直接对应的至少一项具体政策、程序或事实，如员工加班申请、管理人员审批、自愿加班、加班时长控制，或加班异常的处理安排等。","insufficient":"无对应披露，只有支付加班费而没有加班管理内容","topic":"加班申请、审批、自愿性、时长控制、异常处理","actual_current_period_required":false},{"group_id":"T3","indicator_id":"S1.1.3","name":"休息休假保障","condition":"披露员工休息、法定假期、年休假等至少一项明确权利或取得安排。如员工依法享有带薪年假、周休或法定节假日，或披露婚假、产假等具体休假安排。","insufficient":"无对应权利或安排披露","topic":"员工休息、法定假期、年休假及取得安排","actual_current_period_required":false},{"group_id":"T4","indicator_id":"S1.1.3","name":"工时及休假管理机制","condition":"披露至少一项具体工时或休假管理机制或运行事实，如采用考勤系统、记录工时、检查排班、员工申请休假，或办理调休的管理安排。","insufficient":"无对应机制或事实，只有泛泛管理表述","topic":"考勤系统、工时记录、排班检查、休假申请、调休管理","actual_current_period_required":false},{"group_id":"T5","indicator_id":"S1.1.3","name":"实际执行或纠正结果","condition":"披露评分年度实际发生的至少一项工时监测、休假使用、执行覆盖或工时休假侵害纠正结果。如当期检查加班时长、实际使用带薪休假的人数或比例、执行措施覆盖人数，或已纠正的休息权侵害。","insufficient":"无实际执行或结果证据，只有制度、工具名称或未来计划","topic":"当期实际工时监测、休假使用、执行覆盖或工时休假侵害纠正","actual_current_period_required":true},{"group_id":"W1","indicator_id":"S1.1.4","name":"法定社会保障及基本福利","condition":"披露适用员工的至少一项具体法定社会保障或基本福利政策、安排或事实，如养老、医疗、失业、工伤、生育保险，住房公积金或其他运营地适用的法定保障等。","insufficient":"无对应内容，只有无具体项目的笼统合规声明","topic":"法定社会保险、公积金、养老、医疗等基本福利","actual_current_period_required":false},{"group_id":"W2","indicator_id":"S1.1.4","name":"补充福利","condition":"披露面向员工的至少一项具体补充福利安排或事实，如补充医疗、商业保险、企业年金、餐费补助或交通补助等。政策安排和已经发放、投保等事实分别记录。","insufficient":"无对应员工福利披露","topic":"补充医疗、商业保险、年金、餐补、交通补助","actual_current_period_required":false},{"group_id":"W3","indicator_id":"S1.1.4","name":"家庭与生活支持","condition":"披露面向员工的至少一项家庭或生活支持资源、服务或安排，如育儿、托育、家庭照护、心理咨询或员工援助计划（EAP）等。","insufficient":"无对应披露，或内容仅面向社区和客户","topic":"员工育儿、托育、家庭照护、心理支持、员工援助计划","actual_current_period_required":false},{"group_id":"W4","indicator_id":"S1.1.4","name":"福利取得规则","condition":"披露至少一项福利的具体取得规则或明确适用对象，如适用全体在册员工、满足某项申请条件、按规定标准领取补贴，或规定报销及领取方式等。","insufficient":"无对应取得规则，只有活动名称或口号","topic":"福利适用对象、申请条件、补贴标准、报销或领取方式","actual_current_period_required":false},{"group_id":"W5","indicator_id":"S1.1.4","name":"实际覆盖、使用或受益","condition":"披露评分年度已经发生的至少一项福利覆盖、使用或受益事实，如已参保、已缴纳、已为员工投保、补贴已发放、员工已使用服务或具体员工受益案例等。","insufficient":"无已发生事实，只有可申请资格、预算或计划","topic":"当期参保、投保、缴纳、补贴发放、福利使用或受益案例","actual_current_period_required":true},{"group_id":"D1","indicator_id":"S1.1.5","name":"反歧视政策与保障","condition":"明确披露反对或禁止员工相关歧视的政策要求，或至少一项防止就业中不正当差别待遇的具体制度、措施或事实。如禁止因性别、年龄或其他身份特征在招聘、薪酬或晋升中歧视员工等。","insufficient":"完成核查仍无明确对应内容，只有一般多元化倡议或普通招聘晋升管理描述","topic":"员工反歧视政策、禁止歧视要求或具体保障","actual_current_period_required":false},{"group_id":"D2","indicator_id":"S1.1.5","name":"反骚扰政策与保障","condition":"明确披露禁止职场骚扰、反性骚扰或相应零容忍要求，或至少一项保护员工免受骚扰的具体制度、措施或事实。如禁止职场骚扰、开展针对骚扰预防的培训，或提供覆盖职场骚扰的员工保护措施等。","insufficient":"完成核查仍无明确对应内容，只有反腐或一般商业道德表述","topic":"反骚扰、反性骚扰、职场骚扰零容忍或具体防护","actual_current_period_required":false},{"group_id":"D3","indicator_id":"S1.1.5","name":"投诉受理与调查处理","condition":"披露适用于歧视或骚扰投诉的至少一项受理、核查、调查或处理程序，或实际受理调查事实。如明确专门机构接收并调查此类投诉，或披露当期针对歧视骚扰投诉已开展的调查等。","insufficient":"未识别对应机制或事实，只有未说明适用本议题的联系方式","topic":"适用于歧视骚扰投诉的受理、调查、核查或处理","actual_current_period_required":false},{"group_id":"D4","indicator_id":"S1.1.5","name":"申诉人与受影响人员保护","condition":"披露适用于歧视或骚扰投诉的至少一项申诉人或受影响人员保护措施，或实际保护事实，如对投诉人及投诉内容保密、匿名举报、不报复、风险隔离或支持措施等。","insufficient":"未识别对应保护安排或事实","topic":"适用于歧视骚扰投诉的保密、匿名、不报复、隔离或支持","actual_current_period_required":false},{"group_id":"D5","indicator_id":"S1.1.5","name":"责任追究与纠正补救","condition":"披露至少一项针对查实歧视或骚扰的处分、问责或移交处理规则，或具体补救机制、实际处置事实。如对实施者纪律处分、移送处理，或恢复机会、补偿、纠正不公、调整流程和整改复核等。","insufficient":"未识别对应规则、机制或事实，只有无实质内容的“持续改进”","topic":"歧视骚扰的处分、问责、移交及具体纠正补救","actual_current_period_required":false}],"paragraphs":[{"ref_id":"p001","text":"CanSinoBIO complies with the Cybersecurity Law of the People's Republic of China, the Data Security Law of the People's Republic of China, and other applicable laws and regulations. The Company has revised its Information Security Management Procedures and Information Digital Systems Management Procedures, and has separately formulated the Information Security Management Procedures for the Deployment and Application of AI Large Models. By clearly defining principles for information processing, standards for data transmission, and mechanisms to safeguard the rights of personal information subjects, the Company has systematically established a data security management framework that is responsive to technological developments and provides strong support for business innovation and compliant operations.","section":"Information Security","pages":[96],"source_period":"January 1, 2025, to December 31, 2025","source_year":2025,"source_title":"2025 ESG report","source_url":"https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2026/0422/2026042200652.pdf","publisher":"康希諾生物股份公司","evidence_issues":[]},{"ref_id":"p002","text":"During the year, the Company achieved systematic progress in process automation, intelligent collaboration, data security, cybersecurity, and system disaster recovery.","section":"Information Security","pages":[96],"source_period":"January 1, 2025, to December 31, 2025","source_year":2025,"source_title":"2025 ESG report","source_url":"https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2026/0422/2026042200652.pdf","publisher":"康希諾生物股份公司","evidence_issues":[]},{"ref_id":"p003","text":"Process automation | The Company deployed RPA 10 digital employees at scale across a range of high frequency business scenarios, including finance and supply chain, driving automated operations across related processes. This initiative improved operational efficiency by approximately 40%, with processing accuracy exceeding 99.5%.
AI powered collaboration and enhanced decision making | The Company successfully launched the Feishu AI project, deeply integrating artificial intelligence capabilities into daily operations. Through the development of an intelligent knowledge base, the introduction of a meeting assistant, and the use of AI driven business data analysis, the Company enabled real time cross departmental collaboration and strengthened intelligent decision support.
Strengthening of the cybersecurity framework | The Company completed security enhancement and MLPS certification for its industrial control systems and core business platforms, and continued to strengthen its capabilities in proactive defense and real time threat detection.
System disaster recovery management | The Company established a multi center, end to end disaster recovery system, completed offsite disaster recovery deployment for core business systems and production databases, and implemented full data backup. This system enables fault detection within minutes and business switchover within seconds. Multiple disaster recovery drills were conducted throughout the year, and the system recovery success rate remained at 100%.
To comprehensively enhance employees' information security awareness and response capabilities, the Company delivered information security training and assessments to all employees through its E-Learning platform. At the same time, the Company regularly organized phishing email simulation exercises and red team blue team practical drills, effectively strengthening employees' security awareness and real-world defensive capabilities. In 2025, the Company organized four information security and privacy protection training sessions, achieving 100% employee coverage.","section":"Information Security","pages":[96],"source_period":"January 1, 2025, to December 31, 2025","source_year":2025,"source_title":"2025 ESG report","source_url":"https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2026/0422/2026042200652.pdf","publisher":"康希諾生物股份公司","evidence_issues":[]},{"ref_id":"p004","text":"The Company has established an information security governance system and built a five-tier governance structure consisting of the decision-making level, management level, execution level, employees and partners, and supervision level, thereby forming an organizational safeguard system with clear responsibilities and orderly operation.","section":"Information Security","pages":[96],"source_period":"January 1, 2025, to December 31, 2025","source_year":2025,"source_title":"2025 ESG report","source_url":"https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2026/0422/2026042200652.pdf","publisher":"康希諾生物股份公司","evidence_issues":[]},{"ref_id":"p005","text":"CanSinoBIO Information Security Management Structure
